art_direction: Minimal lateral 2D dark-fantasy pixel art, large readable pixel masses, cool blue-violet night and amber fire contrast, no decorative microtexture.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: three-frame gameplay tutorial reference board for a 2D pixel-art game. Primary request: show the same cave-mouth route in daylight as Lolth retrieves wood, herbs and wheel material; show her returning these supplies to the open wagon camp; show night with distinct shadow creatures approaching the camp while an amber fire and a clear nonverbal danger telegraph indicate the wagon is threatened. Style: minimal side-view dark-fantasy pixel art with clean ground, readable loot, sparse parallax. Constraints: no horse, no extra companions travelling beside Lolth, no readable UI text or input labels, no watermark, no floating platform required for the wagon route.
